slides.title: Inaugural Welcome & Dignitary Felicitations
slides.content: Official Portal Launch of ICETICT-2027 | Smart Class Room, Block - I, DRIEMS University
slides.speaker: AIRA (AI Anchor)
slides.speech: A very good morning to all our distinguished dignitaries, respected faculty members, and dear colleagues. Systems online, and ready to begin. On this momentous occasion, I have the distinct privilege of welcoming our esteemed leaders present with us today in the Smart Class Room, Block One: Our respected Director, Administration, S.j. Balaram Kar sir; our esteemed Director, Coordination, Mrs. Chinmayee Rath ma'am; our Associate Dean and Director IQAC, Prof. (Dr.) Alok Ranjan Biswal sir; our Dean, School of Engineering and Technology, Prof. (Dr.) Nayan Ranjan Samal sir; and our Dean Research, Prof. (Dr.) Biswaranjan Mohanty sir. We also extend our heartfelt greetings to our esteemed Convenor, Dr. Amiya Kumar Sahoo, Head of Computer Science and Engineering; our dynamic Co-convenors, Dr. Bajra Panjar Mishra, Assistant Professor in the Department of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering, and Dr. Debayani Mishra, Assistant Professor; as well as all our respected Heads of Departments: Prof. (Dr.) Jibanananda Mehena, Head of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering; Dr. Deepak Ranjan Biswal, Head of Mechanical Engineering; Dr. Anurekha Nayak, Head of Electrical Engineering; Dr. Pratap Chandra Pradhan, Head of Electrical and Electronics Engineering; Dr. Sritam Swapnadarshi Sahu, Head of Civil Engineering; and all the respected faculty members of the School of Engineering and Technology present here today. Today, we gather for the official portal launch of ICETICT-2027 — the 2nd International Conference on Emerging Trends in Intelligent Computing Techniques, organized by the School of Engineering and Technology, DRIEMS University, in association with the IEEE Bhubaneswar Section, under IEEE Conference Record Number 72666, indexed by Scopus. Taking place in hybrid mode on July 16th and 17th, 2027, ICETICT provides a global multidisciplinary forum for scientists, academicians, and researchers to share groundbreaking innovations in intelligent computing. And now, to mark this auspicious milestone and launch our official portal to the world, I most respectfully invite our esteemed Director, Coordination, Mrs. Chinmayee Rath ma'am, to do the honors of unveiling the official conference website.Ma'am, please do the honors of unveiling the portal. Three... Two... One...
slides.pauseNote: Speech ends → auto-advances to Slide 2 curtain for Website Launch by Mrs. Chinmayee Rath.

slides.title: Official Website Launch
slides.content: Launching the Official Conference Portal | icetict.driems.ac.in
slides.speaker: AIRA + Mrs. Chinmayee Rath
slides.speech: Ma'am, please do the honors of unveiling the portal. Three... Two... One... The official website of ICETICT-2027 is now live!
slides.pauseNote: Mrs. Chinmayee Rath cuts the ribbon. Curtains open and the full live conference portal is displayed directly on the screen.
